visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a white T-shirt stands at an outdoor fitness park with metal pull-up bars in the background; he holds a small paper coffee cup and looks at it with a frustrated, squinted facial expression. (2) Indoors, the man sits on a grey fabric sofa with a fluffy orange tabby cat; he looks at a white smartphone with wide eyes and an open-mouthed expression of shock while gesturing toward the device. (3) On a grey stone kitchen countertop, several clear glass bowls containing white flour, yellow butter, and granulated sugar are arranged next to two Meiji brand chocolate bars in their packaging. (4) The man stands in a bright white kitchen, using a wire whisk to mix softened yellow butter and sugar in a large clear glass bowl before adding white flour and kneading it with his hands into a smooth dough. (5) A close-up shot shows hands pressing the yellow dough into the inner walls of a silver aluminum foil cupcake liner to create a hollow cup shape, ensuring the edges are smooth and even. (6) The dough-filled liners are placed inside a small silver and black toaster oven; the heating elements glow bright orange behind the glass door during the baking process. (7) The man holds a golden-brown, baked cookie cup on a white ceramic plate; he uses a silver spoon to carefully spread thick, glossy dark chocolate sauce all over the interior surface of the cup. (8) In a clear glass, the man mixes dark coffee powder with hot water from a white pitcher and stirs it with a black chopstick before adding a stream of white milk. (9) The man pours the prepared coffee into the chocolate-lined cookie cup and takes a sip, smiling and pointing at the camera in a modern kitchen setting with white cabinets. (10) The man holds up a large, clear acrylic display box filled with dozens of small, colorful coffee pods in vibrant yellow, pink, and black containers labeled with 'JUST' branding. (11) A sequence of shots shows the man pouring dark liquid from a black pod into a glass, adding ice cubes, and then pouring a bright orange-colored juice over the top to create a layered beverage. (12) In a final demonstration, the man pours dark coffee into a glass with ice and then adds a significant amount of white milk, which creates swirling marble-like patterns as it mixes with the dark liquid.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced male narration begins with a casual, energetic tone; background music is a high-tempo electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. A sharp 'ding' sound effect plays as the edible cup is first shown on screen. (2) The speaker's voice becomes more rhythmic and intense while listing ingredients; the BGM maintains its energy. A percussive 'thud' or 'clink' sound occurs as bowls are placed on the counter. (3) A series of metallic stirring sounds and soft dough squishing noises are heard, layered over a constant upbeat synth melody. The narration remains clear and enunciated with high arousal. (4) A mechanical 'click' sound of the oven dial is followed by a short silence, then a celebratory 'wow' vocal SFX. The BGM continues with a bright, sharp texture. (5) High-pitched pouring sounds of liquid and the clinking of a spoon against glass are prominent. The narrator's tone is surprised and positive, with a noticeable rise in pitch. (6) A distinct 'pop' sound effect accompanies the opening of a coffee pod, followed by more liquid pouring and ice cubes clinking in a glass. The vocal delivery is fast and persuasive. (7) A female voice briefly interrupts with a humorous, slightly annoyed tone off-camera, followed by the male narrator's laughter and a final upbeat musical swell as he finishes his recommendation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'JUST Coffee' by demonstrating its versatility and ease of use. It uses a creative DIY project (making an edible coffee cup) as a hook to showcase how the coffee pods can be used in various recipes like Americano, fruit-mixed coffee, and lattes, emphasizing both sustainability and convenience.
